items.goal: WebApp no longer throws when a basket line references a product missing from the catalog; missing lines are skipped and the rest of the basket renders on every page.
items.modelReason: Mechanical null-safe dictionary lookup plus two small text edits.
items.verifyReason: The bug breaks every rendered page; a UI check with the basket-edge scenario confirms the pages load.

alternatives.option: Also remove the missing product from the Redis basket
alternatives.reason: This would write to the basket during a read, which goes beyond the minimal fix the story needs; skipping the line meets the Expected behaviour.
